name: UniCast
author: liberuum
description: Discover any Wi-Fi TV or receiver and cast local media (or the file your player is playing) to it over DLNA, Google Cast, or AirPlay, with volume, audio boost and subtitles.

barWidget.description: Cast media to DLNA, Chromecast and AirPlay devices from the Omarchy bar, with volume, boost and subtitles.
